propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot clone but do not appear in the authoritative tickets branch history.
The TICKET_DIGEST file is a superseded derived-cache sidecar for ticket 172e-b207-4c18-4243, older than seven committed digests with the latest at timestamp 1785818168711100662.
The CLAIM_ENRICH file is an expired queue residue with lease expiry 1785821799349015193, superseded by a later claim and completed state in the authoritative history.
Both stranded files are disposable and not unique canonical events requiring recovery through the normal signed store write path.
The persistent clone must reach a clean state with HEAD equal to refs/remotes/origin/tickets and no untracked event files before the A6-1 publication window.
